usageNotes: Retrieves the full configuration of a named PCI hardware mapping, including all node-to-device entries defined under that mapping ID. Caller must hold at least one of Mapping.Use, Mapping.Modify, or Mapping.Audit on the specific mapping path. The 'id' must match an existing pve-configid (alphanumeric/hyphen, no spaces); use list_cluster_mapping_pci to discover valid IDs first.

examples.summary: Fetch the configuration for a GPU passthrough mapping named 'gpu-rtx3090'

tips: The returned object includes per-node device entries (node name, PCI device IDs, IOMMU group, subsystem IDs) — useful for verifying multi-node consistency before live-migrating a VM that uses PCI passthrough.
Mapping IDs follow pve-configid format: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only; underscores are not valid.
If the caller only needs to enumerate available mappings without reading details, use list_cluster_mapping_pci instead to avoid needing per-mapping permissions.
